mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qr_payment_codes ( payee_wallet_id, qr_token, amount, memo, payment_status, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{payeeWalletId}, #{qrToken}, #{amount}, #{memo}, #{paymentStatus}, #{expiresAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT q.qr_payment_code_id, q.payee_wallet_id, q.completed_transfer_id, q.amount, q.memo, q.payment_status, q.expires_at, m.display_name AS payee_name, w.currency_code, w.wallet_status AS payee_wallet_status FROM qr_payment_codes q LEFT JOIN wallets w ON w.wallet_id = q.payee_wallet_id AND w.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN wallet_owners wo ON wo.wallet_owner_id = w.wallet_owner_id AND wo.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN members m ON m.member_id = wo.member_id AND m.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE q.qr_token = #{qrToken} AND q.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT am.appointment_id, am.trip_id, a.appointment_name, t.title AS trip_title FROM appointment_members am JOIN appointments a ON a.appointment_id = am.appointment_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN trips t ON t.trip_id = am.trip_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE am.member_id = #{memberId} AND am.appointment_id = #{appointmentId} AND am.membership_status = 'ACTIVE' AND am.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT qr_payment_code_id, payee_wallet_id, completed_transfer_id, qr_token, amount, memo, payment_status, expires_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM qr_payment_codes WHERE qr_token = #{qrToken} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT qr_payment_code_id, payee_wallet_id, completed_transfer_id, qr_token, amount, memo, payment_status, expires_at, completed_at FROM qr_payment_codes WHERE completed_transfer_id = #{transferId} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT am.appointment_member_id, am.appointment_id, am.trip_id, a.appointment_name, t.title AS trip_title FROM appointment_members am JOIN appointments a ON a.appointment_id = am.appointment_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN trips t ON t.trip_id = am.trip_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE am.member_id = #{memberId} AND am.appointment_id = #{appointmentId} AND am.membership_status = 'ACTIVE' AND am.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
